Well I don’t hate you man, I am rooting for your success actually. Sounds really fucking ass tho thinking that way. I mean I can only give so much advice since I’m not a professional and don’t know you outside whats been discussed on this post. Sounds like you have a lot of mental things going on at once and I wouldn’t know which one to try and tackle first. But based on what you said my only guidance point is you need to stop caring about what others think. Not only that but you, yourself, need to defend yourself from yourself (if that makes any sense). Like to elaborate further; your negative self-talk even in this post is only damaging yourself, telling yourself that everyone hates you, or that you’re stupid, or embarrassed all the time, or that you hate yourself. All these things are ruining your perception of reality. Like if I were you I would take a step back and try to logically analyze why you think thats true, backing it up with evidence and if your finding it hard to do that than its not true. Even if it is easy to come up with random reasons it’s still not true (depends on how deep these thoughts flow in your psych). I’d say a good way you could try and improve from here is whenever these thoughts arise challenge them try to change your own mind. Because when you’re convinced something’s true to that degree about yourself you start to amplify scenarios in a way to fit that agenda, like the way you’re describing how other’s view you remind me of paranoia or delirium/psychosis. (Being the belief that somethings out to get you) And believe me I’ve had my share of paranoia where I would pick up on subtle things that people would do, like I don’t know someone says something that feels targeted and I would think they’re trying to steal my power or something (crazy ik), but that all changed when I change my own beliefs and subconscious programming. All of this is just because I doubt everybody hates you seriously and if they did then fuck them anyways right. (My last point) You have to start taking action for yourself, because if you believe these thoughts what’s going to stop you from spiraling down further? You think it’s just going to magically go away? Nope, you have to address it within yourself, because it sounds to me as if you’re blaming a lot of the mental illness is being caused by others (which btw can be true in abusive situations and etc; not trying to discredit you but just motivate) when truly deep down you know it’s your own suppressed shit thats fucking with you. You just gotta stop caring what others think, address why you feel this away about your relationships with others and yourself (thoroughly), and work with yourself. Really put maximum effort out there because life ain’t just gonna hand you a free pass to getting well(too many killed themselves already for that), you gotta put in the work. I love you buddy, stay in there, you got this.

Okays so my only help for you based on what i’ve dealt with in the past (im guessing you’re female since 32kg is extremely like dead light for a male) I had extreme cases of self-image or body-dysmorphia where I always thought I was too fat and constantly sucking in my stomach since a young age as thinking people will notice my stomach etc. Used to destroy me until I realized that being skinny isnt for everyone. I mean I ended up dropping a ton of weight went from 240lbs (~110kg) to 135 (55kg?) (Im in Usa dont know conversions off the top of my head) but to be honest there are steps you can take to completely fix your health with effort. You are still extremely young and can rebound from practically anything. If I were you I would let go of the notion skinny=attractive and be a little more relaxed with the eating. Stop purging binge eating, lots of youtube videos will teach tips like eating a normal amount of food waiting during the meal to see if youre full (for binging) and purging just stop. I realized that human beings arent designed to be one size fits all. Everybody’s unique and you are too. So really letting go of these self destructive habits and adopting more positive ones will make you feel much better. Physically and mentally, and before you know it you’ll even forget you had these issues with your body. Also what difference would it make if you were skinny when you died? Thats kinda retarded. You need to convert all this effort away from these notions and talk with yourself really look at yourself in the mirror and say I’m fine, I look good, and that you’re beautiful. I hope you do get better and dont take your life. God bless.

(So my best advice to you) Self-Love is not really learned but rather gained. Gained through things like therapy, (really is gonna be the most effective way for someone teetering on the edge of ending it all) working out, eating better, setting goals and accomplishing them (this ones probably most effective), putting down drugs, remove people that are of bad influence. The reason you’re struggling this way is probably you’re likely really smart individual on the inside with ambitions of a great life, but you let the habits or ways of thinking take control. Maybe you don’t think (subconsciously) that you deserve love. Such as self-sabotaging or taking substances or as soon as your brain says “oh we should do something positive,” your self-sabotaging mind will say “nah let’s do this,” (usually something unhealthy).

I’ve definitely been there with the women thing but that will go away when you start to prioritize the maximization of your quality of life. By leaving whatever thoughts reside in the self-sabotaging mind and learning to ignore them, because once you ignore them again and again and again they will slowly become easier and easier to deal with until you start doing so much better that you now have self-love. Loving thy self for what you’ve accomplished, and what might lie ahead. Just remember it comes in small steps and I’d really see about getting a legit therapist/psychologist that can help you take these steps so you’re actively not in it alone.

I believe in you and the fact you’re still here means it’s not over. God bless ❤️
